seo.title: About Kasi Transport | Petaling Jaya Logistics Company Since 2005
seo.description: Transport roots since 1996, established 2005. Meet the team behind Kasi Transport, a Petaling Jaya logistics operator serving Peninsular Malaysia.

intro.title: Transport roots since 1996.
intro.text: Kasi Transport was established in 2005 and runs from Petaling Jaya, moving cargo and equipment for businesses and live productions across Peninsular Malaysia.

manifesto.text: Be on time. Keep the load safe. Do the right thing. We have held to those three rules since our transport roots in 1996, for every client who trusts us with their cargo.

journey.title: From transport roots to a growing network.
journey.text: Nearly three decades of road experience, and a business built around dependable service.

steps.title: Our transport roots
steps.text: The transport experience behind Kasi Transport begins on the road in 1996, well before the company was formally established. Those years shaped the way we plan routes and schedules, and how we look after the drivers who run them.

steps.title: Kasi Transport is established
steps.text: Kasirajan officially establishes Kasi Transport in Petaling Jaya, turning years of road experience into a registered transport business. From the start, the focus is on precision, competence and reliability.

steps.title: Into large-scale live events
steps.text: From Yuvan Live in Malaysia in 2022 to Coldplay, BLACKPINK, Jay Chou and A.R. Rahman in 2023, plus festivals such as Pinkfish, Good Vibes and Peakstorm, Kasi Transport moves production equipment around venue access and tight show schedules.

steps.title: Commercial linehaul and a growing network
steps.text: Today Kasi Transport supports scheduled linehaul and parcel distribution for corporate customers, alongside commercial transport, event logistics and specialised loads. The work is carried by company-operated trucks and employed drivers, backed by a growing network of independent transport partners.

items.title: Precision
items.text: Routes, schedules and documents are planned and checked, so nothing is left to chance.

items.title: Competence
items.text: Experienced drivers and a team that knows the road, the load and the paperwork.

items.title: Reliability
items.text: When we say we will be there, we are. Customers can plan their business around us.

items.title: Professionalism
items.text: Clear communication, tidy paperwork and respectful dealings with customers, drivers and suppliers.
